title: Flat and cartoony, as asked — against the 3-D-ish one you rejected
question: You said the last one looked 'kinda 3d-ish' and asked for flatter or more cartoony. A is that same rejected version. B drops the volume shading entirely and replaces it with a flat fill plus a drawn edge. Is B the direction — and if it still isn't, is the problem the smoothing itself or how far it goes?
context_md: Same stand, same frame, same 14,857 plant cells, no simulation change. A and B differ only in how the reconstructed shape is coloured: A shades every lobe with a lit and a shaded side (that is the 3-D reading you named), B fills each shape flat and inks a dark edge just inside the outline instead. The smooth silhouette is identical in both.
